notes: No Wikiquote page. The note is verbatim on American Rhetoric's transcript of the pitch: 'A shoe is just a shoe -- until somebody steps into it. Then it has meaning.' (Sonny); TV Tropes gives the same words. NYU News reports Deloris corrects it later: 'A shoe is just a shoe until my son steps into it.' 7-Eleven clerk and barefoot Phil Knight on TV Tropes. Rolling Stone: 'Sonny getting a fat haul in Vegas', which backs the prawn cocktail line. The still under the poster is Phil Knight (Affleck) at his desk; no caption.

vibe.verdict: A Nike staff canteen in 1984 with the draft slip, the $250,000 and Sonny's line is a smart fit, but every dish is a themed stand-in and the voice is plain.
